curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What begins as a modest bid to save a failing roadside motel suddenly turns into half a million people descending on a quiet upstate farm.
curatedMovie.description: Hoping to bring business to his parents' struggling Catskills motel, Elliot Tiber offers up local grounds for an ousted music festival, inadvertently sparking the massive gathering of Woodstock.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A warm, medium-paced blend of comedy and drama with moderate emotional weight and steady engagement.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Ang Lee reframes a legendary counterculture milestone through intimate family dynamics and the chaotic logistics of an unexpected historical turning point.
